column1: # Key of the cipher of Vincenzo Badalocchio, agent in Rome of the Duke of Nevers, December 1592 to February 1593.
# One table for the three letters of this folder (BnF fr. 4700 f. 85r, f. 65r, f. 80r) and the passage of f. 83r.
# State: 11 October 2026, after the audit. No key sheet of this cipher is known to us.
# value: a raised dot = a null (no meaning); ? = no value. "a/b" = open between two words.
# kind:  letter; null; table1 = a word of the table 1xy; table2 = a word of the table 2xy; ending = a syllable at the
#        end of table 2; name = the dotted stroke and three figures; number = a number in clear; open = no value.
# grade: sure = a clear word fixes the value in two places or more, or in one place where no other word fits;
#        probable = one place, or the sense is not complete, and the order of the alphabet allows the word;
#        guess = the place allows other words; open = no value.
# f085r, f065r, f080r, f083r = how many times the group stands on each page (decode.py counts them again).
# note:  the words that fix the value. CAPITALS mark the place of the group in the word. u and v are one letter.
